articles.summary: Neymar couldn’t figure out what was bothering him about the ball he was about to use for the match. He turned it over from side to side, let it bounce, rolled it around and kept inspecting it, clearly noticing something felt off. He even looked around to see if anyone else had noticed what was bothering him, but no one seemed to react. At first glance, the ball did appear slightly bigger, leaving Neymar genuinely confused. He eventually went over to check the other balls set out for warmups, inspecting them one by one. Somehow, none of them seemed to convince him either.
